arxiv-2107-01654.title: Efficient Explanations for Knowledge Compilation Languages
arxiv-2107-01654.creator: Xuanxiang Huang, Yacine Izza, Alexey Ignatiev, Martin C. Cooper, Nicholas Asher, Joao Marques-Silva
arxiv-2107-01654.description: Abstract Knowledge compilation (KC) languages find a growing number of practical uses, including in Constraint Programming (CP) and in Machine Learning (ML). In most applications, one natural question is how to explain the decisions made by models represented by a KC language.

arxiv-2203-12536.title: Dynamically Refined Regularization for Improving Cross-corpora Hate Speech Detection
arxiv-2203-12536.creator: Tulika Bose, Nikolaos Aletras, Irina Illina, Dominique Fohr
arxiv-2203-12536.description: Abstract Warning: this paper contains content that may be offensive and distressing. Hate speech classifiers exhibit substantial performance degradation when evaluated on datasets different from the source. This is due to learning spurious correlations between words that are not necessarily relevant to hateful language, and hate speech labels from the training corpus.

arxiv-2204-12993.title: Counterfactual harm
arxiv-2204-12993.creator: Jonathan G. Richens, Rory Beard, Daniel H. Thompson
arxiv-2204-12993.description: Abstract To act safely and ethically in the real world, agents must be able to reason about harm and avoid harmful actions. However, to date there is no statistical method for measuring harm and factoring it into algorithmic decisions. In this paper we propose the first formal definition of harm and benefit using causal models.

arxiv-2303-02194.title: Astrophysical and electromagnetic emissivity properties of black holes surrounded by a quintessence type exotic fluid in the Scalar-Vector-Tensor Modified Gravity
arxiv-2303-02194.creator: Tiberiu Harko
arxiv-2303-02194.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Tiberiu Harko. The astrophysical consequences of the presence of a quintessence scalar field on the evolution of the horizon and on the accretion disk surrounding a static black hole, in the Scalar-Vector-Tensor version of Modified Gravity (MOG), are investigated. The positions of the stable circular orbits of the massive test particles, moving around the central object, are obtained from the extremum of the effective potential. Detailed calculations are also presented to investigate the light deflection, shadow and Shapiro effect for such a black hole.

The MAROON-X observations were collected under program GN-2021B-Q-103. The TESS data presented in this
arxiv-2304-00797.creator: James Sikora, Jason Rowe, Saugata Barat, Jacob L. Bean, Madison Brady, Jean-Michel Désert, Adina D. Feinstein, Emily A. Gilbert, Gregory Henry, David Kasper, Déreck-Alexandre Lizotte, Michael R. B. Matesic, Vatsal Panwar, Andreas Seifahrt, Hinna Shivkumar, Gudmundur Stefánsson, Julian Stürmer

arxiv-2312-05126.title: Inferring the dark matter splashback radius from cluster gas and observable profiles in the FLAMINGO simulations. 2023 Inferring the dark matter splashback radius from cluster gas and observable profiles in the FLAMINGO simulations. – B
arxiv-2312-05126.creator: Imogen Towler, Scott T. Kay, Joop Schaye, Roi Kugel, Matthieu Schaller, Joey Braspenning, Willem Elbers, Carlos S. Frenk, Juliana Kwan, Jaime Salcido, Marcel P. van Daalen, Bert Vandenbroucke, Edoardo Altamura
arxiv-2312-05126.description: Abstract The splashback radius, coinciding with the minimum in the dark matter radial density gradient, is thought to be a universal definition of the edge of a dark matter halo. Observational methods to detect it have traced the dark matter using weak gravitational lensing or galaxy number counts.

arxiv-2404-13383.title: Quasi-Frobenius Novikov algebras and Pre-Novikov bialgebras
arxiv-2404-13383.creator: Yue Li, Yanyong Hong
arxiv-2404-13383.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yue Li, Yanyong Hong. Pre-Novikov algebras and quasi-Frobenius Novikov algebras naturally appear in the theory of Novikov bialgebras. In this paper, we show that there is a natural pre-Novikov algebra structure associated to a quasi-Frobenius Novikov algebra. Then we introduce the definition of double constructions of quasi-Frobenius Novikov algebras associated to two pre-Novikov algebras and show that it is characterized by a pre-Novikov bialgebra. We also introduce the notion of pre-Novikov Yang-Baxter equation, whose symmetric solutions can produce pre-Novikov bialgebras.

arxiv-2410-09329.title: Zero-shot Commonsense Reasoning over Machine Imagination
arxiv-2410-09329.creator: Hyuntae Park, Yeachan Kim, Jun-Hyung Park, SangKeun Lee
arxiv-2410-09329.description: Abstract Recent approaches to zero-shot commonsense reasoning have enabled Pre-trained Language Models (PLMs) to learn a broad range of commonsense knowledge without being tailored to specific situations. However, they often suffer from human reporting bias inherent in textual commonsense knowledge, leading to discrepancies in understanding between PLMs and humans.

arxiv-2410-24162.title: Conformalized Prediction of Post-Fault Voltage Trajectories Using Pre-trained and Finetuned Attention-Driven Neural Operators
arxiv-2410-24162.creator: Amirhossein Mollaali, Gabriel Zufferey, Gonzalo Constante-Flores, Christian Moya, Can Li, Guang Lin, Meng Yue
arxiv-2410-24162.description: Abstract This paper proposes a new data-driven methodology for predicting intervals of post-fault voltage trajectories in power systems. We begin by introducing the Quantile Attention-Fourier Deep Operator Network (QAF-DeepONet), designed to capture the complex dynamics of voltage trajectories and reliably estimate quantiles of the target trajectory without any distributional assumptions.

arxiv-2412-02982.title: Quantum Birthmarks: Ergodicity Breaking Beyond Scarring
arxiv-2412-02982.creator: Anton M. Graf, Saul Atwood, Mingxuan Xiao, Roland Ketzmerick, Eric J. Heller, Joonas Keski-Rahkonen
arxiv-2412-02982.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Anton M. Graf, Saul Atwood, Mingxuan Xiao, Roland Ketzmerick, Eric J. Heller, Joonas Keski-Rahkonen. A hallmark of classical ergodicity is the complete loss of memory of the initial conditions due to eventual uniform covering of a priori available phase space.

arxiv-2502-08887.title: Dark Energy from Time Crystals
arxiv-2502-08887.creator: Laura Mersini-Houghton
arxiv-2502-08887.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Laura Mersini-Houghton. In this work, we analyze a scalar field model which gives rise to stable bound states in field space characterized by nonzero motion that breaks the underlying time translation symmetry of its Hamiltonian, known as time crystals.

arxiv-2509-17831.title: The origin of the intra-cluster light in The Three Hundred simulations
arxiv-2509-17831.creator: A. Contreras-Santos, A. Knebe, W. Cui, I. Alonso Asensio, C. Dalla Vecchia, R. Haggar, R. A. Mostoghiu Paun, F. R. Pearce, E. Rasia, G. Martin, S. E. Nuza, G. Yepes
arxiv-2509-17831.description: Abstract We investigate the origin and formation mechanisms of the intra-cluster light (ICL) in The Three Hundred simulations, a set of 324 hydrodynamically resimulated massive galaxy clusters. The ICL, a diffuse component comprised of stars not bound to any individual galaxy, serves as a critical tracer of cluster formation and evolution.

arxiv-2510-13789.title: T3former: Temporal Graph Classification with Topological Machine Learning
arxiv-2510-13789.creator: Md. Joshem Uddin, Soham Changani, Baris Coskunuzer
arxiv-2510-13789.description: Abstract Temporal graph classification plays a critical role in applications such as cybersecurity, brain connectivity analysis, social dynamics, and traffic monitoring. Despite its significance, this problem remains underexplored compared to temporal link prediction or node forecasting. Existing methods often rely on snapshot-based or recurrent architectures that either lose fine-grained temporal information or struggle with long-range dependencies.

pmc-10612221.title: Case report: video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery for pulmonary arteriovenous malformation using near-infrared fluorescence with indocyanine green
pmc-10612221.creator: Tianxiao Han, Jian Gao, Zhenfan Wang, Jian Zhou
pmc-10612221.description: BackgroundPulmonary arteriovenous malformation (PAVM) is an abnormal communication between pulmonary vasculatures and has an unclear boundary with surrounding lung tissues. At present, surgeons can only determine its location by preoperative imaging and intraoperative palpation, despite its soft texture. Indocyanine green(ICG), a near-infrared fluorophore, has been demonstrated useful in the accurate identification of vascular tissue.

pmc-10622882.title: 3D bioprinted breast tumor-stroma models for pre-clinical drug testing
pmc-10622882.creator: Patricia González-Callejo, Paula Vázquez-Aristizabal, Clara García-Astrain, Dorleta Jimenez de Aberasturi, Malou Henriksen-Lacey, Ander Izeta, Luis M. Liz-Marzán
pmc-10622882.description: The use of three-dimensional (3D) bioprinting has been proposed for the reproducible production of 3D disease models that can be used for high-throughput drug testing and personalized medicine. However, most such models insufficiently reproduce the features and environment of real tumors.

pmc-11443093.title: Time and dose selective glucose metabolism for glucose homeostasis and energy conversion in the liver
pmc-11443093.creator: Yifei Pan, Atsushi Hatano, Satoshi Ohno, Keigo Morita, Toshiya Kokaji, Yunfan Bai, Hikaru Sugimoto, Riku Egami, Akira Terakawa, Dongzi Li, Saori Uematsu, Hideki Maehara, Suguru Fujita, Hiroshi Inoue, Yuka Inaba, Atsushi J Nagano, Akiyoshi Hirayama, Tomoyoshi Soga, Shinya Kuroda
pmc-11443093.description: Hepatic glucose metabolism serves dual purposes: maintaining glucose homeostasis and converting glucose into energy sources; however, the underlying mechanisms are unclear. We quantitatively measured liver metabolites, gene expression, and phosphorylated insulin signaling molecules in mice orally administered varying doses of glucose, and constructed a transomic network.

pmc-11531741.title: Assessing population structure and morpho-molecular characterization of sunflower (Helianthus annuus L.) for elite germplasm identification
pmc-11531741.creator: Sampath Lavudya, Kalaimagal Thiyagarajan, Sasikala Ramasamy, Harish Sankarasubramanian, Senthivelu Muniyandi, Anita Bellie, Sushil Kumar, Susmitha Dhanapal
pmc-11531741.description: Sunflower (Helianthus annuus L.), known for its adaptability and high yield potential, is vital in global edible oil production. Estimating genetic diversity is a key pre-breeding activity in crop breeding. The current study comprised of 48 genotypes which were assessed for their biometrical traits at department of Oilseeds, Tamil Nadu Agricultural University, during the rainy season of 2022.

pmc-11606913.title: Predictors of mortality and severe illness from Escherichia coli sepsis in neonates
pmc-11606913.creator: Adriana Hoffman, Sriram Satyavolu, Danah Muhanna, Sindhoosha Malay, Thomas Raffay, Anne Windau, Eric M. Ransom, Devashis Mukherjee
pmc-11606913.description: Neonatal Escherichia coli (E. coli) sepsis is increasing. There is limited data on the factors contributing to increased mortality and severity of illness in neonatal E. coli sepsis. A retrospective review of neonates (<30 days) admitted to a Level IV NICU in the United States from 2008 to 2022 diagnosed with E. coli bloodstream or cerebrospinal fluid infection was conducted.

pmc-11652097.title: Exploring How the Kidney BEAM Physical Activity Digital Health Intervention Improved Mental Health-Related Quality of Life for People Living With Kidney Disease
pmc-11652097.creator: Ellen M. Castle, Roseanne E. Billany, Hannah M.L. Young, Christy Walklin, Juliet Briggs, Elham Asgari, Sunil Bhandari, James O. Burton, Kate Bramham, Vashist Deelchand, Alexander Hamilton, Mark Jesky, Philip A. Kalra, Kieran McCafferty, Andrew C. Nixon, Maarten W. Taal, James Tollit, David C. Wheele
pmc-11652097.description: IntroductionThe Kidney BEAM randomized controlled trial reported clinically meaningful and statistically significant improvements in mental health-related quality of life (HRQoL), physical function (sit-to-stand-60, but not the physical component of HRQoL) and patient activation after a 12-week physical activity digital health intervention (DHI). This study explores factors that contributed to the effectiveness of Kidney BEAM through mixed methods analyses.

pmc-12087601.title: Cierre quirúrgico de la orejuela izquierda durante la cirugía cardiaca: artículo de revisión
pmc-12087601.creator: Pedro Iván Rojas Sánchez
pmc-12087601.description: RESUMENLa oclusión quirúrgica de la orejuela izquierda durante la cirugía cardiaca ha demostrado disminuir el riesgo de stroke y embolia sistémica de forma significativa en los pacientes con fibrilación auricular, siendo actualmente un procedimiento con un alto grado de recomendación.

pmc-12595366.title: Qualitative Analysis and Comparison of Externally Led Patient-Focused Drug Development Concepts for Autosomal Recessive Polycystic Kidney Disease Against SONG Initiatives
pmc-12595366.creator: Belle Soyfer, Sorin Fedeles, Wendy Ruyle, Elise Hoover, Max C Liebau, Erum A Hartung, Katherine M Dell, Lisa M Guay-Woodford, Ronald D Perrone, Dorothee Oberdhan
pmc-12595366.description: Autosomal recessive polycystic kidney disease (ARPKD) is a rare, inherited condition associated with pathogenic variants in the PKHD1 gene, leading to fibrocystin dysfunction. ARPKD carries significant morbidity, involving progressive kidney dysfunction that often necessitates transplantation or dialysis. Liver complications commonly accompany renal manifestations and contribute to marked clinical heterogeneity and challenging disease management.

pmc-13216583.title: Impact performance and probabilistic reliability of natural fiber-reinforced standard and high-strength concrete
pmc-13216583.creator: Ajila Hexil S, Karthikeyan Kothandapani
pmc-13216583.description: The development of sustainable high-performance concrete has increasingly emphasized the incorporation of natural fibers to improve mechanical and impact resistance. This study presents a comprehensive and novel investigation of multiple natural fibers, coconut (0.5–1.5%), flax (0.1–0.5%), jute (0.15–0.55%), and bamboo, hemp, and kenaf (0.25–1.25%), evaluated in two concrete grades (M25 and M80).

pmc-13379248.title: TPI1 Loss Triggers a Metabolite‐Driven Mitochondrial Redox Vulnerability via the SARM1–cADPR–Ca2+ Axis
pmc-13379248.creator: Chunyu Liu, Shun Wu, Chuang Wang, Zirui Zhou, Tianwei Cai, Wen Tao, Shidong Zuo, Chi Zhang, Yuhao Dong, Yi Feng, Qingbo Huang, Baojun Wang, Xin Ma, Haoli Ma, Xu Zhang, Yan Huang
pmc-13379248.description: Cellular senescence is a stable cell cycle arrest program with important therapeutic implications in cancer, yet how metabolic perturbations are translated into redox‐dependent senescence remains incompletely understood. Here, we identify triosephosphate isomerase 1 (TPI1) as a critical regulator of senescence in clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) through a customized CRISPR‐Cas9 metabolic screen.

pmc-13387421.title: Psychobiological and Psychosocial Responses of Nurse-Initiated Management of Antiretroviral Therapy–Trained Nurses Caring for People Living With HIV: Protocol for a Scoping Review
pmc-13387421.creator: Phodzo Desire Tshelani, Muimeleli Munyadziwa, Lufuno Makhado, Javad Sarvestan
